title: Can Progressives Deliver Economic Growth?
gist: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani's appointment of Anthony Shorris and Lina Khan to run the city's Economic Development Corporation is read as an admission that the left cannot deliver affordability through taxation and regulation alone, and must pair redistribution with a supply-side growth agenda.

insights.claim: No jurisdiction can tax and regulate its way to affordability, so redistributive programs must be paired with a growth agenda that expands good jobs and productive capacity.
insights.speaker: RICK MCGAHEY
insights.so_what: Municipal-level left populism that ignores supply-side capacity risks fiscal strain and out-migration of the tax base — watch city budgets and bond spreads where redistribution outruns growth.
insights.quote: no jurisdiction can tax and regulate its way to affordability
insights.locator: At a time of historic inequality

insights.claim: Historic inequality combined with inadequate public investment is the condition that makes left-wing redistributive policy 'badly needed' rather than merely popular.
insights.speaker: RICK MCGAHEY
insights.so_what: Frames a structural, not cyclical, driver of the redistribution agenda — implies political durability beyond one election cycle.
insights.locator: At a time of historic inequality and inadequate public investment

insights.claim: Mamdani named Anthony Shorris president and Lina Khan board chair of New York City's Economic Development Corporation, filling two vacancies that had been left open in the administration.
insights.speaker: RICK MCGAHEY
entities: New York City Economic Development Corporation
insights.so_what: Lina Khan moving into a NYC development role is a concrete signal for how antitrust-minded governance may be applied to real-estate, procurement, and development deals in the largest US city.
insights.locator: TEMPE—When New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani

insights.claim: The EDC appointments are best read as an acknowledgment that the left has long struggled to deliver economic growth alongside economic redistribution, not merely as routine hiring.
insights.speaker: RICK MCGAHEY
insights.so_what: If progressive city administrations pivot toward growth and productive capacity, expect more pro-development and industrial-policy posture than headline rhetoric implies.
insights.quote: how to deliver not only economic redistribution but also economic growth
insights.locator: He also underscored his recognition of a key challenge
